_comment: Optional --map file for: node scripts/importDataset.js --type faculty --file <csv> --map import-mappings/faculty.json
`columns` maps an exact CSV header (as it appears in your file) to a Faculty schema field, and takes precedence over the built-in header synonyms below.

`defaults` fills a field for every row whose CSV cell is blank; --department fills `department` afterwards for whatever is still blank (--year/--semester/--academicYear don't apply here, Faculty has no such fields).
Built-in header synonyms (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive; see utils/importNormalizers.js HEADER_SYNONYMS.faculty) — no --map needed if your headers already match one of these:
teachername, teacher, instructor, facultyname, name -> name (required)
email -> email (required, unique, upsert key when present)
dept, department, school -> department (required unless --department is passed; also the fallback upsert key with name, when email is blank)
expertise, skills, specialisation, specialization, subjects -> specialization (split on , ; | /, deduplicated, casing preserved — used for fuzzy course matching)

availability -> availability (free text, e.g. "Mon-Fri 09:00-17:30" or "Mon 09:00-12:00; Tue 14:00-17:00"; unparseable defaults to Mon-Fri 09:00-17:30, weekends empty; a blank cell uses that default on insert and leaves the stored value untouched on update)
